source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-15: A Dirge for Sarkoris

items.name: Blightburst
items.text: When a blighted fungus leshy dies, a burst of rotted compost explodes from its body, dealing 3d6 slashing damage and 1d6 poison damage to each creature in a 30-foot emanation. This area then fills with blighted fungi, becoming difficult terrain until the fungi wither 24 hours later.

items.name: Change Shape
items.text:
The blighted fungus leshy transforms into a Small, sickly-looking giant mushroom or patch of fungi. This ability otherwise uses the effects of One with Plants.

---

items.name: Spore Cloud
items.text: A blighted fungus leshy can unleash a cloud of spores that irritates the eyes and throats of non-fungi creatures in a 15-foot emanation. Each creature must succeed at a DC 18 Fortitude save save or take 2 persistent,poison damage. On a failure, a creature has its vision range reduced to 20 feet (10 feet on a critical failure) as long as the persistent damage continues.

items.name: Spores
items.text: A creature damaged by a blighted fungus leshy's spore pod Strike must attempt a saving throw with the same DC and effect as its Spore Cloud ability.
